tables.name: receptionist_patient_view
tables.definition:
SELECT id,
    clinic_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    cedula,
    phone,
    email,
    created_at
   FROM public.patients;

policies.policyname: Medical staff can view clinical records
Authenticated users can submit data rights requests
policies.with_check: ((clinic_id = (((auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata'::text) ->> 'clinic_id'::text))::uuid) AND public.is_clinic_member(clinic_id) AND (user_id = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (resolved_by IS NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NULL) AND (resolution_notes IS NULL))

policies.policyname: Clinic members can view data rights requests
Clinic owners can update data rights requests
Clinical staff can insert patient files
Clinical staff can update patient files

policies.qual: ((clinic_id = (((auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata'::text) ->> 'clinic_id'::text))::uuid) AND (public.get_clinic_member_role(clinic_id) = ANY (ARRAY['clinic_owner'::text, 'doctor'::text])) AND public.check_subscription_active(clinic_id) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))
policies.policyname: Clinical staff can view patient files

policies.qual: ((clinic_id = (((auth.jwt() -> 'app_metadata'::text) ->> 'clinic_id'::text))::uuid) AND (public.get_clinic_member_role(clinic_id) = ANY (ARRAY['clinic_owner'::text, 'doctor'::text])) AND public.check_subscription_active(clinic_id) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

triggers.name: trg_enforce_clinician_assignment
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_clinician_assignment BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF doctor_id, clinic_id ON public.appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION security_internal.enforce_clinician_assignment()

triggers.name: trg_enforce_clinician_assignment

triggers.name: trg_audit_data_rights_status
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_data_rights_status AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.data_rights_requests FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status) EXECUTE FUNCTION security_internal.audit_data_rights_status()
